oneLine: Indiabulls to acquire 70% stake in Fintech Cloud at Rs 1500 Cr.

sources.title: Indiabulls to acquire 70% stake in Fintech Cloud at Rs 1500 Cr

synopsis: Indiabulls Limited has signed an agreement to acquire a 70 percent stake in Delhi-based financial operator firm Fintech Cloud Private Limited. The transaction has an equity valuation of Rs 1500 crore, with the consideration to be settled through the issuance of up to 21 crore fully paid-up equity shares of Indiabulls Limited. The deal is structured through an NCLT-approved scheme and is subject to NCLT, SEBI, stock exchange, and other regulatory and shareholder approvals. The acquisition procedure is expected to take between nine months and a year. Prior to completion, Indiabulls will appoint the majority of directors to Fintech Cloud's board with immediate effect.
